name: Krishna Filament Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Krishna Filament Industries Ltd is in the business of HDPE/PP Ropes[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KFIL is a Surat-based Textile Group which manufacture warp knitted fabrics Tricot fabrics and woven Fabrics. Its products include synthetic ropes made of polypropylene and high-density polyethylene, twine and nets.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
